rows.name:
Gorman took only a limited supply of his medicine in[XENO:n ]
the escape from Colony 6. If it runs out, he'll be[XENO:n ]
in trouble. Collect ingredients for Olga to make more.

Collect 5 lots of [System:Color name=item ]Glowing Wisp Fluid[/System:Color] from Wisps[XENO:n ]
on the Giant God's Leg.
Return to Olga.

Gorman can sleep now that Olga has the[XENO:n ]
ingredients to make his anti-insomnia medicine.

Tatsu's grandson has broken a toy belonging to his[XENO:n ]
friend. To fix it, Tatsu needs some Sticky Web Fibres.[XENO:n ]
Collect some to help Tatsu fix the toy.

Collect 3 [System:Color name=item ]Sticky Web Fibre[/System:Color] from Arachno[XENO:n ]
on the Giant God's Leg.
Return to Tatsu.
Give the toy to Kiroro.
Return to Tatsu.

Now that the toy has been repaired, the two[XENO:n ]
friends have made up.

Pamu is feeling the pain of losing his parents. To bring[XENO:n ]
a smile back to his face, pay Ewan the author a visit[XENO:n ]
and speak to him about making a picture book.
Speak to Ewan.

Collect 3 pieces of [System:Color name=item ]Ponio Neck Meat[/System:Color] from Field[XENO:n ]
Ponios on the Giant God's Leg.
Speak to Ewan.
Return to Matryona.

With a distinct air of positivity, Ewan has begun[XENO:n ]
work putting the picture book together.

Matryona is the inspiration that set Ewan on his path[XENO:n ]
to writing the story. Collect the Sour Gooseberries[XENO:n ]
he needs to make paints for Matryona's pictures.
Collect 4 [System:Color name=item ]Sour Gooseberries[/System:Color] on the Giant God's Leg.
Report back to Ewan.
Give the paints to Matryona.
Return to Ewan.

Thanks to Ewan's newly-found drive, he and[XENO:n ]
Matryona's relationship is much improved.

A glimpse of the future shows Pamu drowning![XENO:n ]
If nothing is done to stop him, he'll surely die.[XENO:n ]
Change the future and don't let Pamu drown!

Collect 1 [System:Color name=item ]Lake Drop[/System:Color] from near Raguel Lake on[XENO:n ]
the Giant God's Leg.
Return to Matryona.
Give the picture book to Pamu.

The picture book has changed and the tragedy of[XENO:n ]
Pamu drowning has been averted.

A glimpse of the future shows Pamu drowning![XENO:n ]
It looks like it's going to happen if he goes to the river[XENO:n ]
alone. Don't let Pamu go there on his own!

Collect a [System:Color name=item ]Medicinal Herb[/System:Color] from near Tranquil[XENO:n ]
Grotto on the Giant God's Leg.
Speak to Arda.
Return to Matryona.
Give the picture book to Pamu.

Arda received the back medicine meaning[XENO:n ]
Pamu no longer visits the river on his own.

Tirkins took the refugees' clothes while they were[XENO:n ]
hanging out to dry. If nothing is done, there won't be[XENO:n ]
enough to go around. Find and retrieve the clothes.

Collect the [System:Color name=item ]Clothes[/System:Color] from the Tirkin Headquarters[XENO:n ]
on the Giant God's Leg.
Return to Gorman.

The stolen clothes have been recovered from[XENO:n ]
the Tirkins.

The residents are finding it difficult to catch fish. They[XENO:n ]
believe a monster that has settled by Raguel Lake is[XENO:n ]
to blame. Defeat the monster.

Defeat the [System:Color name=item ]Abnormal Brog[/System:Color] near Raguel Lake on[XENO:n ]
the Giant God's Leg.
Return to Tatsu.

The fish-eating monster that settled by Raguel[XENO:n ]
Lake is gone and a food crisis has been averted.

Man-eating Volff are closing in on a girl while she[XENO:n ]
bathes. Go and rescue her before it's too late!

Defeat the 4 [System:Color name=item ]Ferocious Volff[/System:Color] near the waterfall on[XENO:n ]
Gaur Plain.
Speak to the girl.

The girl who went bathing alone is safe. She[XENO:n ]
won't be coming back here alone any time soon!

Apparently there is an everlasting ether deposit very[XENO:n ]
close by. Leave the camp, head right and into a small[XENO:n ]
cave where it is supposedly concealed.
Search the area around the ether deposit.
Return to Earnest.

You found nothing but normal crystals.[XENO:n ]
Looks like Earnest pulled a fast one!

There is supposedly an endless supply of crystals in a[XENO:n ]
cave on the edge of Raguel Lake, south east of the[XENO:n ]
bridge. Go there and find out if this is really the case.
Search the area around the ether deposit.
Return to Earnest.

After giving him the benefit of the doubt, it looks[XENO:n ]
like Earnest tricked you...again!

There seems to be a reason behind Earnest's lies.[XENO:n ]
Place flowers on the grave of his friend at the edge[XENO:n ]
of the cliff north of Kasharpa Waterfall.
Place the flowers on the grave.

Defeat the [System:Color name=item ]Arrogant Tirkin[/System:Color] to the north of[XENO:n ]
Kasharpa Waterfall on the Giant God's Leg.
Return to Earnest.

The darkness in Earnest is gone. No more[XENO:n ]
dishonest antics from him!

Baldo went off in search of ingredients for Grelee[XENO:n ]
and his dinner, but his poor sense of direction got him[XENO:n ]
lost. Find out where he is.

Locate Baldo near Raguel Lake on the[XENO:n ]
Giant God's Leg.
Return to Grelee.

Baldo has been found and won't be heading[XENO:n ]
off alone in future.

Baldo wants to give someone a gift of gratitude.[XENO:n ]
There are two key ingredients needed to make[XENO:n ]
Secret Nopon Elixir. Find them on Baldo's behalf.

Collect a [System:Color name=item ]Tokilos' Egg[/System:Color] from near Zax Guidepost[XENO:n ]
on the Giant God's Leg.

Collect a [System:Color name=item ]Pandora Mushroom[/System:Color] from Windy Cave[XENO:n ]
on the Giant God's Leg.
Return to Baldo.

It was you Baldo was planning on giving a gift[XENO:n ]
to! A fitting reward for your efforts.

This time Baldo has gone to find a flower to give to[XENO:n ]
someone without your help. Unfortunately, he's lost[XENO:n ]
his way and you have to find him again!

Locate Baldo on a high place east of[XENO:n ]
Zax Guidepost on the Giant God's Leg.

Head to the top of the large waterfall on the[XENO:n ]
Giant God's Leg and collect the [System:Color name=item ]Ether Wisdom[/System:Color].
Return to Baldo.

Baldo has proven just how unreliable he is but[XENO:n ]
he promises that it won't happen again.

The Mythical Empress is on a rampage fuelled by the[XENO:n ]
death of her young and is destroying the area around[XENO:n ]
the nest. Head there and put her out of her misery.

Defeat the [System:Color name=item ]Mythical Empress[/System:Color] near Zax Guidepost[XENO:n ]
on the Giant God's Leg.
Return to Grelee.

The Mythical Empress has fallen and the legend[XENO:n ]
has come to an end.

Collect a single blossoming flower for Durand from[XENO:n ]
the Tephra Cave ruins.

Collect 1 [System:Color name=item ]Ancient Lily[/System:Color] from near Bafalgar Tomb[XENO:n ]
in Tephra Cave.
Return to Durand.

The Ancient Lily has been delivered to Durand,[XENO:n ]
but who will be the final recipient?

Durand can't make his Ancient Lily delivery as[XENO:n ]
planned. Head to Tephra Cave and defeat the two[XENO:n ]
large monsters fighting each other.

Defeat [System:Color name=item ]Reckless Zanden[/System:Color] at the Arachno Queen's[XENO:n ]
Nest in Tephra Cave.

Defeat [System:Color name=item ]Firework Geldesia[/System:Color] at the Arachno[XENO:n ]
Queen's Nest in Tephra Cave.
Return to Durand.

The monsters in Tephra Cave have been[XENO:n ]
eliminated to ensure safe passage to Colony 9.

Some of the evacuated High Entia are holed-up in[XENO:n ]
Satorl Marsh. They are running dangerously low on[XENO:n ]
food. Find them some food to replenish their reserves.
Give goods to Seagal in Satorl Marsh.

The Satorl refugees have received food from the[XENO:n ]
camp. Life should be a little easier for them now.

Monsters are drawing closer and attacking people.[XENO:n ]
It's time to defeat the monsters once and for all.
Defeat 2 [System:Color name=item ]Leg Ardun[/System:Color] on the Giant God's Leg.

The Homs Traveller is out of harm's way at last.[XENO:n ]
Maybe it was just him being a little too friendly...

Monsters are wreaking havoc among the wildlife on[XENO:n ]
the great Gaur Plain. Head there and defeat them.
Defeat 3 [System:Color name=item ]Maker Bunnits[/System:Color] on the Giant God's Leg.

Quest completed. Hopefully there will be less[XENO:n ]
unrest from now on.

Some extremely ferocious monsters have shown up[XENO:n ]
on Gaur Plain. Defeat them to clear a safe passage.
Defeat 5 [System:Color name=item ]Field Ponios[/System:Color] on the Giant God's Leg.

Quest completed. Things should be safer for[XENO:n ]
travellers from now on.

Travellers hear howling while making camp and it is[XENO:n ]
making them uneasy. Locate and eliminate the source[XENO:n ]
of the howling.
Defeat 3 [System:Color name=item ]Leg Volff[/System:Color] on the Giant God's Leg.

Quest completed. It's again safe to camp without[XENO:n ]
the unnerving howling ringing through the air.

A trip to see the fireflies has been thwarted by some[XENO:n ]
monsters. They'll have to be cleared before the trip.[XENO:n ]
Defeat the monsters and make it safe.
Defeat 2 [System:Color name=item ]Basin Antols[/System:Color] on the Giant God's Leg.

Quest completed. Now there shouldn't be any[XENO:n ]
problem going to see the fireflies.

Mechon are preventing the search for survivors. If[XENO:n ]
there's to be any chance of finding anyone alive,[XENO:n ]
Mechon need to be cleared. Defeat the Mechon.
Defeat 5 [System:Color name=item ]Mechon M64[/System:Color] on the Giant God's Leg.

Quest completed. The search for survivors[XENO:n ]
should be much easier now.

A recent surge in the Tirkin population is posing an[XENO:n ]
increased danger to survivors. To keep the people out[XENO:n ]
of harm's way, bring the Tirkin population down.
Defeat 2 [System:Color name=item ]Brave Tirkins[/System:Color] on the Giant God's Leg.

Quest completed. Now the survivors can feel[XENO:n ]
a little more secure.

A request has been made to help keep the camp's[XENO:n ]
inhabitants out of harm's way. Defeat the monster[XENO:n ]
that is putting the people in peril.

Defeat [System:Color name=item ]White Eduardo[/System:Color] at Raguel Lake on the[XENO:n ]
Giant God's Leg. (Only during a thunderstorm.)

Quest completed. You have taken care of the[XENO:n ]
monster. The inhabitants of the camp are safe.

There is a monster rampaging between Viliera Hill and[XENO:n ]
Sky Stage. It will need to be defeated before the[XENO:n ]
errand can be taken care of.

Defeat [System:Color name=item ]Violent Andante[/System:Color] from Sky Stage on the[XENO:n ]
Giant God's Leg.

Quest completed. The rampaging monster is no[XENO:n ]
longer a threat.

A monster has overrun an area where people forage[XENO:n ]
for much-needed provisions. Defeat the monster and[XENO:n ]
reclaim this cherished area.

Defeat [System:Color name=item ]Trainer Harmelon[/System:Color] near the north part of[XENO:n ]
Spiral Valley on the Giant God's Leg upper level.

Quest completed. The area has been freed from[XENO:n ]
this monster and is safe to visit again.

A noticeably larger-than-usual Tirkin has been[XENO:n ]
spotted. He'll need to be taken care of before he sets[XENO:n ]
his sights on the camp. Defeat him.

Defeat [System:Color name=item ]Vagrant Alfead[/System:Color] in the Tirkin Headquarters[XENO:n ]
on the Giant God's Leg.

Quest completed. The threat posed by the large[XENO:n ]
Tirkin is no more.

Occasionally, it would be nice to feed the camp's[XENO:n ]
inhabitants some food that galvanises their spirits.[XENO:n ]
Collect some ingredients that would do the trick.

Collect 2 lots of [System:Color name=item ]Brog Leg Meat[/System:Color] from Brogs on[XENO:n ]
the Giant God's Leg.

Collect 2 [System:Color name=item ]Fertile Flamii Eggs[/System:Color] from Flamii on[XENO:n ]
the Giant God's Leg.

Quest completed. This should help raise the[XENO:n ]
spirits of the camp's inhabitants a little.

The refugees fled with nothing more than the clothes[XENO:n ]
on their backs. Collect the materials needed to make[XENO:n ]
additional clothing.

Collect 2 [System:Color name=item ]Tirkin Crests[/System:Color] from spear-carrying[XENO:n ]
Tirkins on the Giant God's Leg.

Collect 2 [System:Color name=item ]Tirkin Tail Feathers[/System:Color] from bow-carrying[XENO:n ]
Tirkins on the Giant God's Leg.

Quest completed. Now the much-needed clothes[XENO:n ]
can be made.

In order to bring a little happiness to the inhabitants[XENO:n ]
of the camp, go and retrieve a Bunnit Sapling.

Collect 1 [System:Color name=item ]Bunnit Sapling[/System:Color] from a Slugger[XENO:n ]
Bunnit on the Giant God's Leg.

Quest completed. Hopefully this sapling will[XENO:n ]
help cheer people up.

The unfortunate people who've fallen foul of bad[XENO:n ]
circumstances would like some amulets. Collect the[XENO:n ]
materials that the Nopon suggested.

Collect 3 [System:Color name=item ]Vang Third Molars[/System:Color] from Vangs on[XENO:n ]
the Giant God's Leg.

Quest completed. This should be enough teeth to[XENO:n ]
make amulets and put peoples' minds at ease.

Food at the camp leaves a lot to be desired. If more[XENO:n ]
flavour can be added to the food, things will get a lot[XENO:n ]
better. Find the collectables required to do this.
Collect 2 [System:Color name=item ]Clear Almonds[/System:Color] from Tephra Cave.

Quest completed. Food should be a lot more[XENO:n ]
flavoursome from now on.

A little girl wants nothing more than some pet insects[XENO:n ]
to call her own. Make her day by finding some[XENO:n ]
collectables.
Collect 3 [System:Color name=item ]Moth Crawlers[/System:Color] on the Giant God's Leg.

Quest completed. She should be a little happier[XENO:n ]
now she has some new friends to play with.

While fleeing the bridge, she dropped a present from[XENO:n ]
her boyfriend and it's too risky for her to return there[XENO:n ]
alone. Locate the present on her behalf and return it.

Collect the [System:Color name=item ]Bird Necklace[/System:Color] from near Raguel[XENO:n ]
Bridge on the Giant God's Leg.

Quest completed. The ill-fated present has been[XENO:n ]
successfully recovered.

A gift from some friends has been swept away by the[XENO:n ]
wind and its recipient is in no condition to go and[XENO:n ]
retrieve it himself. Find the gift and return it.

Collect the [System:Color name=item ]Torn Paper[/System:Color] from Gaur Plain on[XENO:n ]
the Giant God's Leg.

Quest completed. The precious gift has been[XENO:n ]
successfully recovered, intact and safe.
